title: Grok Build manifest traps
body: In .grok-plugin/plugin.json and .grok-plugin/marketplace.json, anchor every path with ${GROK_PLUGIN_ROOT} and never with ${VAR:-default} (Grok expands ${VAR} only), and name the marketplace plugin source by git URL, not "./" (its marketplace rejects it as "marketplace path is empty"). `grok plugin validate` passes on all of these, so check a change with `grok inspect` from an isolated HOME/USERPROFILE. Why: found on Grok 1.0.41 on 2026-09-23 with the v1 manifest, which also inlined an mcpServers object Grok ignored; v2 registers hooks only, mirroring hooks/hooks.json, and no live Grok session has been recorded since.
not_derivable: Grok accepts the broken manifests without an error; only a live grok mcp doctor and inspect showed what it ignored.

evidence.summary: The manifest layout and each finding from grok mcp doctor on 2026-09-23.
